acceptance.criterion: Required mode automatically runs a hard-time-bounded live canary only when matching successful evidence is absent, and persists a private evidence artifact on success or failure.
acceptance.evidence: AutomaticPrewalkQualificationTests proves cache miss qualification, private success and attempt artifacts, and matching cache reuse.

acceptance.criterion: A successful canary proves exact session continuity, route change, the same worktree, one logical stream, retained guide context, and one packet before real prewalk starts.
acceptance.evidence: The canary lifecycle test proves the same exact session, route-bound phases, changed temp-worktree fact, structured stream identity, retained guide fact, and packet_sent_count 1.

acceptance.criterion: Failed or incomplete qualification stops required launch with the evidence path and no task worker launch.
acceptance.evidence: Failure and runtime-error tests assert prewalk_live_qualification_failed, private attempt evidence, and no task launch path.

acceptance.criterion: Experimental mode is explicit and honestly reported, requires advertised exact resume and route override, and preserves all runtime trajectory and authority checks.
acceptance.evidence: Experimental capability and route tests prove advertised grammar is required, identical routes are rejected, honest state is reported, and the real supervisor checks remain active.

acceptance.criterion: Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build use the same qualification and runtime invariants, with host-specific invocation syntax covered by tests.
acceptance.evidence: Host profile, adaptive routing, native prewalk, and CLI tests cover equivalent Codex, Claude Code, and Grok Build policy.

acceptance.criterion: Docs, guide, changelog, and version metadata describe the shipped behavior consistently.
acceptance.evidence: check_repo_consistency.py and release_checklist.py --version 2.21.0 pass across SKILL, AGENTS, README, guide, references, changelog, and version pins.

master_acceptance.criterion: A user can request required prewalk without manually preparing qualification evidence.
master_acceptance.evidence: native-worker launch --prewalk required invokes automatic live qualification when matching proof is absent.

master_acceptance.criterion: Qualification failure stops before task launch and names durable private evidence.
master_acceptance.evidence: Bounded canary failure paths persist redacted .attempt.json evidence and stop before launch_native_worker.

master_acceptance.criterion: Experimental mode changes only the qualification threshold, not trajectory or authority enforcement.
master_acceptance.evidence: experimental_prewalk_capabilities changes capability admission only; build and supervisor paths retain exact-session, worktree, packet, artifact, Git, and fallback checks.

master_acceptance.criterion: Claude Code, Codex, and Grok Build have equivalent user-visible semantics.
master_acceptance.evidence: Host parity docs and routing/native-worker tests cover all three supported main drivers.

master_acceptance.criterion: The exact release tip passes full verification and Fugu review, has green PR checks, and is ready for landing and global installation.
master_acceptance.evidence: verify_repo.py --ci reports 1424 passing tests and all release gates; Fugu deep review findings are closed; PR #216 checks verify the committed tip before landing.
